subject: CONFIRMED: FoldInteractive telemetry is display-coupled; current single default-display anchor is fragile
body: CONFIRMED from current main source + physical Fold7 field bundle. GitHub HEAD 413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace uses exactly one FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER anchor bound to Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY and replaces it when the default display key changes. AOSP routes sendWallpaperCommand from the supplied window token through that WindowState's DisplayContent.mWallpaperController. Physical SM-F966W / Android SDK 36 capture shows the current reader timing out while folded/cover wallpaper identity is none, then immediately producing ~111-112 successful samples/s once inner logical display 0 becomes active and wallpaper identity switches to live/FoldInteractive. Transition Lab totals: 2491 poll-due, 1516 poll-complete/control-accept, 971 poll-timeout. Success windows 94210.270-94220.069s and 94227.437-94231.499s; timeout windows dominate outside those intervals. This strongly supports maintaining per-display wallpaper anchors and polling both relevant anchors during handoff, rather than following only DEFAULT_DISPLAY. The upstream duo-fold-live LiveAngles implementation independently uses primary + secondary anchors and commands both when dualActive. Lead should treat sendWallpaperCommand return/no-exception as dispatch attempt only; confirmation is a fresh matching FoldInteractive log response. Affected: WallpaperAngleFeed, display topology sync, angle freshness/recovery, diagnostics. Agents 01,03,07,08,09,10 should care. No production change made by this agent.
